verdict.rationale: Portal das Finanças is a government tax and customs service, so a documented system-to-system channel with a published enrollment path is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack shows only human-facing portal functions: registration and login, electronic notifications, services for certified accountants, and customs lookups. Nothing documents webservices, system accounts, transmitter programs, batch submission or an enrollment path for software, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
